transport: CoolProp 8 provides no viscosity/thermal-conductivity model for NitrousOxide; tank heat-transfer closure uses CO2 (CoolProp) at the same reduced temperature as a corresponding-states surrogate (ASSUMED).
verdict: In the operating window 15-25 C (and up to 300 K) the two representations agree within 0.98 % (P, rho_l, rho_v, h_fg); below 290 K within 0.72 %; 300-305 K within 2.2 %. Within 4 K of Tc the deviations grow to 48 % (h_fg) because the two critical points differ (Tc 309.52 vs 309.57 K) and saturated properties vary steeply there. Use: CoolProp with ~1 % property uncertainty up to 300 K (27 C), ~2 % to 305 K; 30-36 C (never a planned condition: ENG-12 20+/-3 C) is a hazard regime, not a design point.
